a set of genes, which expression is altered in papillary thyroid carcinomas (PTC), can be used as a molecular diagnostic tool for the preoperative PTC identification.
the combination of SFTPB upregulation and TFF3 downregulation is highly specific for PTC and can be used for differential molecular diagnosis.
the expression levels of two genes, SFTPB and TFF3, may be used as markers of papillary thyroid carcinoma.

the possibility of using molecular markers for differential diagnosis of thyroid tumors.
the development of a new method of molecular diagnostics for PTC.
the development of a new molecular diagnostic tool for PTC that can be used in clinical practice.

the molecular diagnosis of thyroid tumors using a combination of selected marker genes is a promising tool for the differential diagnosis of thyroid tumors.

molecular diagnostic method proposed in this study is a valuable adjunctive tool for preoperative PTC differential diagnosis, especially in cases where the histological diagnosis is difficult to establish on the basis of conventional morphological and immunohistochemical examination of FNAB samples.
